title: docs(adr): ADR-0160 — record-scoped AI inquiry: the ai_context type, get_record_context, conversation focus, ask_ai, skill context, citation shape
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MnWaznGZTAkFkVJLEdmiKM)_

Fixes #36997
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR is the design text only. After it merges, the owning seat files rows 5–10 of epic #36996 from the record's implementation split.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。这是一份设计文档，把「在一条记录上问 AI」的做法写定：资料包怎么声明、怎么按提问人的权限读、怎么经一个工具交给模型（应用内助手和外部 MCP 拿到的是同一份），以及「问 AI」按钮、对话焦点、技能指定资料包、答复引用的格式。
- 为什么做：专题 #36996 的后续子卡（资料包类型与工具、「问 AI」按钮、Studio 编辑界面、技能接资料包、cloud 端首轮预读、答复引用）都等这份文档。
- 出错会怎样：文档本身不影响线上。它定的是 AI 读记录的边界：一律以提问人的权限读；读不到的值从不交给模型；读不到的关联记录直接不出现、不留编号；拒绝和答复里不出现提问人看不到的对象名、字段名；记录里的文字一律包成「资料」交给模型，不当指令。
- 要你做什么：审核通过后合并。文中有 12 处是卡面原话之外的落点，单列在「Points that go past the card's words」一节。其中三处会改变用户看到的东西，文中写明要你明确同意，不同意可以逐条划掉：
  - 第 10 点（看不到的字段怎么说）：专题裁决写「看不到的字段显示『你看不到』」，但 ADR-0106 规定普通用户连字段名都看不到（名字本身会泄露）。文档的落法：提问人自己的界面里看得到这个字段名的，照旧点名写「你看不到」；看不到字段名的，只说「这份资料里有部分内容你看不到」，不点名、不计数。另两种做法没采用：对谁都点名（违反 ADR-0106），或什么都不说（达不到专题裁决）。
  - 第 2 点：资料包点名的某个关联对象，提问人整个对象都没有读权限时，整次调用拒绝，而不是只少这一块。后果是权限窄的角色在这条记录上点「问 AI」什么也拿不到，作者要为不同角色写不同的资料包。另一种做法是去掉这一块、照第 10 点的说法写明「有部分内容你看不到」，其余照给。
  - 第 1 点：一个对象上有多个资料包时，「问 AI」按钮和对话焦点不指定用哪个，会被拒绝（除非当前技能指定了资料包）。每个对象只配一个资料包就没有这个问题。
- 审核经过：独立契约审核三轮，第一轮 1 条必改、3 条应改，第二轮再提 1 条应改，全部改完关闭；第三轮通过，只剩两条不影响正确性的小意见，按规矩记为接受的偏差不再改动。

## What changes

- **New record, ADR-0160** (Proposed), built on cloud ADR-0119 (Accepted 2026-11-24, objectstack-ai/cloud#4960). D1–D9 decide the card's items 1–9 in order; item 10 (field egress) is in "Not decided here".
  - D1: `ai_context` passes ADR-0088's admission test. Strict schema, six v1 keys (`name`, `label`, `object`, `fields`, `related`, `body`), each read by the render service in the PR that adds the type (ADR-0049). Body fallback to knowledge search is named as later work.
  - D2: the object-level AI keys (`enable.aiReadable` and the refused write arms) stay as ruled; a pack grants nothing and hides nothing.
  - D3: the render contract — every read is the caller's and is the read a record tool already makes. Objects are judged first (root, then each `related` child; a refusal refuses the whole call, #35145), then fields are projected onto the caller's served schema, then surviving lookups' targets. A field the caller's schema shows but cannot read is named withheld (#35137); a field the schema hides is not named and one non-naming statement says some material is not visible (`membersWithheld` precedent, point 10). Unreadable related rows absent; no id for an unopenable lookup; long body as an outline with anchors; one envelope in three parts (data, executor notes, framing sentence), owner proposed `@objectstack/core`.
  - D4: `get_record_context` — zod I/O in spec beside the dataset tools, one executor, MCP and the product registry; `data:read`, read family. Order of judgement: arguments, the root object's gates (before any pack lookup), pack selection with no fallback, then D3's order. Naming bound: no answer names an object, field or pack the caller is not served. The seams for cloud#4969: an ordinary tool call, a read, and a read set derivable from the arguments and published metadata by one exported function.
  - D5: the render service proposed as `@objectstack/service-record-context` under `packages/services/`, by the dataset/knowledge executor precedent.
  - D6: `ToolExecutionContext.focus` restated exactly as #36999 fixes it; `get_record_context` takes no `focus`.
  - D7: `ActionType` gains `ask_ai` — console-only, calls the focus setter, no target, never an AI tool, absent where the assistant surface or the focus capability is absent.
  - D8: `SkillSchema` gains `context?: string`; a skill that declares it must bind `get_record_context` in `tools`. MCP skill prompts take one optional record-id argument and carry the call's arguments as one JSON object instead of inlining the pack.
  - D9: citation shape `{ object, id, anchor?, quote }`; no schema until its reader (row 10).
  - An implementation split table carries epic rows 5–10 with lane, blocker and expected `Metadata-protocol:`.
- **`docs/adr/README.md`** regenerated by `pnpm adr:index` (one row, the counts).

Read first, by risk:

1. D3 "The pack is projected before its reads are planned", "Object level" and "Field level", and D4 "Order of judgement", "The naming bound" and "The seams" — the permission boundary and what cloud#4969 builds on.
2. "Points that go past the card's words", points 1, 2 and 10 — the three the record hands to the maintainer.
3. D6 against #36999's card text (must match it word for word in substance).

## Tests

None: the diff is two files under `docs/adr/`. No behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Every position the record cites was read on `main` at `e1dee7ae` and is written as a symbol anchor; `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` resolves them.
- Corrections to the card's premises, found by reading the tree:
  - "the object-level `ai` key" is the `enable.aiReadable` read key plus the refused write-arm spellings (`packages/spec/src/data/ai-read-exposure.ts`, `object.zod.ts#CAPABILITIES_AI_WRITE_ARM_GUIDANCE`); the record spells it so.
  - No shared "data, not instructions" wrapper exists today (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts#textResult` serializes JSON only); the record names one owner as a proposal.
  - ADR-0149 D2 exists in two forms: the dataset tools declare zod in spec, `search_knowledge` keeps JSON Schema in its service. The record follows the dataset form and says so.
  - A lookup whose target the caller may not read is not refused by the record tools; the engine leaves it unexpanded (`packages/objectql/src/engine-reference-name-visible.ts`). The record therefore says each read meets the gates the record tool making the same read meets.
  - `ai.exposed` is ADR-0011's block; ADR-0066 is not cited for it.
- Contract review, three rounds (brief 7143243476): round 1 on `fa8cdc93` FAIL (M1, S1–S3; record 7143262163); round 2 on `81bd066b` PASS with S4 open (record 7143637250); round 3 on `1fc38533` PASS, `No must-fix, no should-fix.` (record 7143824235).
- Accepted deviations (round-3 nits, left unfixed because a fix moves the governed head): N10 — an expansion has two gates in the tree and only the system-object guard refuses; a target whose API exposure does not serve `get` is withheld by `servedExpand` and renders as an unexpanded lookup, which the record's sentence "Where the record tools do not refuse, the pack does not either" already decides. N11 — Provenance item 4 and the Status line still speak of one approver, while the Points section hands points 1, 2 and 10 to the maintainer; the Points section governs.
- Not filed, by rule: rows 5–10. They are filed after this merges.

## Verification

Head `1fc3853349219086768123e814c6369208a29b47` (base `e1dee7ae`; two patch commits on `fa8cdc93`, no merge of main). Local, on each round's final text, the families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives for `docs/adr/**`, all exit 0:

```text
0  pnpm adr:index            (unchanged on the final text)
0  pnpm check:adr-index
0  pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors
0  pnpm check:adr-anchors
0  pnpm check:closed-ceremony-text
0  pnpm check:doc-authoring
0  pnpm check:pm-prior-rulings
0  node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs
```

Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. This PR stays draft; landing waits for an authorized approval or the maintainer's merge. `skip-changeset`: the diff publishes nothing from any package.
